messages:
marc: kicking off staged cutover for model cometa-13b-v2-quant on /gen route. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% across 2h change window. Pinlist: /search and /docs remain on comet-13b-v1 for now. Fallback order will be comet-13b-v1 -> titan-7b-fp16 -> grub-7b-quant. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. :rocket:

deploy-bot: STARTED canary rollout 1718001234 for model=cometa-13b-v2-quant targets=[/gen] canary=10%

sophia: quick Q — should we pin the embeddings route too? embeddings workload is sensitive to quantization diffs.

marc: yes, pin embeddings -> comet-embed-2. I'll add it to the pinlist and update the release note.

jen: what are explicit rollback signals here? pro-tip: codify them now so ops can act fast.

marc: rollback triggers: (1) error rate increase > +5% absolute, (2) p95 latency > 1200ms for >5m, (3) eval quality regression > 3% (see eval job eval-3342). Also cost spike >30% is a hard stop.

sam: +1 on cost. Add token-cost delta >30% to the signal set. We saw surprises last time.

ops-bot: acknowledged. Pinlist updated: /search,/docs,/embeddings -> comet-13b-v1,comet-embed-2. Guardrails attached to rollout.

marc: deploy-bot hold at 10% for 25m for telemetry collection, then proceed if stable. Will monitor real-time eval and latency dashboards.

deploy-bot: CANARY PAUSED at 10% — awaiting manual approval or timeout (25m).

sophia: ran a quick safety pass vs prod-guardset-7 on a sample of 250 prompts — no major hallucination pattern changes.

marc: good. approving proceed to 50% at +26m unless ops flags anything.

deploy-bot: PROGRESS: canary->50% started (jobs scheduled on eu-edge nodes). ETA ~8m.

jen: realtime eval eval-3342 shows -1.8% quality delta (within tolerance). No auto-rollback.

sam: cost delta during 10% = +12% (within expected). continuing to monitor.

deploy-bot: ROLL_COMPLETE: 100% traffic switched at 1718001390. Post-roll: watch latency for 2h, drain v1 pods, run post-deploy smoke evals.

marc: starting drain of old pods and creating a 2h pinwatch. If any rollback signal fires we'll pin back to comet-13b-v1 and cut traffic immediately.

sophia: adding runbook link and quick checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollbacks — includes commands for emergency pin and rollback.

deploy-bot: REMINDER: automatic rollback can be executed via `/deploy rollback pinlist add --route /gen --model comet-13b-v1` or manual pin via console.
